patch_description: This proposal keeps the fixed data re-uploading, RX feature map, training loop, and measurement mapping unchanged, but replaces the heavy CNOT-compressor ansatz with a more symmetry-regularized line-phase kernel. It draws inspiration from the prior orbit-sharing and tic-tac-toe line motifs, but uses a different mechanism: a D4-symmetric local phase decoder, a fixed CZ “interaction graph” over all legal adjacent grid edges, then trainable CRY line aggregators that softly collect endpoint evidence into row/column midpoints and the center. The design avoids the overly destructive bit-flip behavior of dense CNOT compression, reduces trainable parameters relative to the current program, and aligns the final orbit-shared readout mixers with the fixed cross/edge, circle/corner, and draw/center observables.
